flora: Ginkgoites (stately hardwood-profile trees with deeply lobed, fan-shaped leaves)
Clusters of leaves growing on short wood spurs
Fleshy, plum-like seeds along the branches
environment_details.style_notes: STYLE_ANIMATED_FEATURE_V3; fan leaves should have highly distinct, deeply cut lobes (often divided into narrow segments); graphical outline foliage; thick, clean leaf edges to suit the animated style.

visual_logic.composition: A wide, cinematic shot of a mature Ginkgoites tree standing in a clearing at the base of a basalt cliff. The foliage shows a mix of deep forest green and early patches of soft mustard yellow.
visual_logic.ground: A striking contrast layer of fallen, deeply-lobed yellow leaves scattered over a dark gray volcanic ash floor.
visual_logic.lighting: SUNNY_EXPOSED_CINEMATIC; clear afternoon light casting crisp, graphical shadows of the fan leaves onto the dark ground below.
